stories.title: Sources: Colts willing to trade Taylor, active in talks with multiple teams
stories.summary: The Colts now are open to trading Jonathan Taylor, sources told ESPN and NFL Network, and multiple teams have reached out to Indianapolis.

stories.title: Records reveal 3 other women accused Packers' Jacobs of abuse after arrest
stories.summary: Three other women contacted police to detail allegations of abuse against Packers RB Josh Jacobs following his May arrest for an altercation with his then-girlfriend.

stories.title: 'No way' that Jets trade star WR Wilson before deadline, source says
stories.summary: The Jets are not expected to trade Garrett Wilson, sources told ESPN, despite increased speculation about the star wide receiver's future.

stories.title: LeBron too much for Knicks late in what Nurse calls 'his best game' as 76er
stories.summary: LeBron James rescued Philadelphia late against the Knicks in what coach Nick Nurse called his best game as a Sixer.

stories.title: Sources: Packers, Parsons target return for Thanksgiving Eve game vs. Rams
stories.summary: The Packers and Micah Parsons are targeting the Thanksgiving Eve game against the Rams for his return to the field, sources told NFL Network.
